resources.string: Let the home screen or the app behind shine through the keyboard

To read your wallpaper, GlassType needs the \"Photos and videos\" permission (please choose \"Allow all\"). On devices where that is not enough, \"All files access\" is requested next. Without permission, choose your wallpaper image manually via \"Set background image\" – it will be aligned to the screen the same way.
Hold to hide the keyboard briefly
The app is not pushed up by the docked keyboard. Combined with \"Real see-through\" the app content shines through the keyboard. Quick toggle in the toolbar.
Uses the speech recognition of your phone directly in the keyboard. Live text while speaking, no plugin needed.
No speech recognition service found. Install or enable \"Speech Recognition and Synthesis from Google\" or Samsung voice input.
Speech recognition is busy, please try again
